fusions.name: Seeding Glance
fusions.desc: Fires a seed that deals 4 damage and poisons the target for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds. Its damage rises by 10% per affliction the target carries, to a maximum of 40%.

fusions.name: Taproot Stare
fusions.desc: A thrown thorn that deals 32 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and deals 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Held Ground
fusions.desc: Raises a growth where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Patient Harvest
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict an enemy, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
